quickIndex.title: ROOM INDEX
headline: Everything in
the room.
quickIndex.description: Use this index for a direct route through the work. The room adds process, artifacts, and open questions to the formal case files.

computer.label: COMPUTER
computer.hint: Formal project and experience records are filed here.
computer.log: The desktop contains the clearest account of each project: the problem, implementation, evidence, and current limit.

drawer.label: DESK DRAWER
drawer.hint: Physical and working evidence sits beneath the workbench.
drawer.log: The drawer holds prototypes, CAD artifacts, evaluation packets, and the public-safe traces of applied engineering work.

notebook.label: RESEARCH BOOK
notebook.hint: The margins record decisions, revisions, and what remains uncertain.
notebook.log: The notebook follows a design question through alternatives, implementation choices, results, and corrections.

books.label: BOOKSHELF
books.hint: Personal books and films will be filed here.
books.log: The shelf is reserved for books, films, and the personal notes worth keeping from them. Its first entries have not been filed yet.

board.label: NOTE BOARD
board.log: The board records the methods that connect the projects: preserve uncertainty, name tradeoffs, and make systems legible before changing them.

fieldcase.label: FIELD CASE
fieldcase.hint: Future observations and experiences will be filed here.
fieldcase.log: The case is currently unfiled. It is reserved for places, activities, observations, and field tests that belong outside the formal project records.
